jobs.occupation: Senior Data Expert with focus on Policy & Compliance (m/f/d) (Bioinformatiker/in)
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionAt Roche, we are passionately committed to improving the lives of patients. This is what motivates us to come to work every day. We are dedicated to scientific rigor, uncompromising ethical principles, and ensuring access to medical innovation for all. Through our work today, we strive to create a better future.Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies can accelerate R&D. Seamless access to trustworthy, well governed data across gRED and pRED is essential to realizing these opportunities.Within the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence, Data & Digital Catalysts modernizes our computational and data ecosystems and integrates digital technologies across Research and Early Development. The Data Capability helps scientists find, understand, access, and use data responsibly and efficiently.Your Key ResponsibilitiesJoin the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Senior Data Expert, Policy & Compliance (m/f/d) in the Compliance by Design team. You will make responsible data and AI use workable in scientific R&D by translating legal, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy requirements into clear decisions, guidance, and processes. Based in Penzberg, you will combine strong local scientific partnership with work across pRED and gRED, and lead matrixed project teams to improve how data is governed, accessed, reused, and prepared for computational use. In doing so, you will take on the following exciting tasks:* You will plan, contribute to, and in certain cases lead policy, compliance, and data governance projects of increasing complexity. Furthermore, we may ask you to lead matrixed project teams involving scientific, data, technology, and compliance stakeholders to coordinate the outcome from scope to implementation. * Most importantly, you are the one to translate legal, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy requirements into practical requirements for scientific and data workflows. In this translational process you will design workable processes and controls and support the respective implementation and adoption.* You will act as a subject matter expert in one or more relevant areas, e.g. scientific data quality, data lifecycle management, data governance or AI and data policy* It will be up to you to build trusted relationships with scientific and data stakeholders in Penzberg and across pRED and gRED. You will also represent scientific needs in broader policy, governance, and technology initiatives so that resulting solutions are both compliant and workable.* You will identify material compliance, data quality, and operational risks in complex or ambiguous situations. This may also include the development of pragmatic recommendations and mitigation approaches to bring unresolved decisions to the appropriate owner.* You will also develop and improve methods for assessing data quality and policy compliance and create reusable implementation resources. Moreover, you are expected to share expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to a strong OneRoche data culture.Who you are To successfully take on this role, you should possess the following qualifications:* An advanced degree (Bachelor or Master) in a scientific or technical field, such as information science, data science, bioinformatics, computer science, or a related life science discipline* 3-5 years relevant experience in pharmaceutical R&D, data management, data governance, information compliance, or a similar environments* Deep expertise in at least one relevant scientific or data domain, with the ability to guide projects and workstreams based on that expertise* Demonstrated experience leading projects or workstreams of increasing complexity and coordinating matrixed teams without direct authority* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn complex or ambiguous requirements into pragmatic recommendations and workable processes* Excellent communication and relationship building skills across scientific, technical, policy, Legal, Privacy, and leadership audiences. This also implies the ability to translate between science and data requirements. * Very good written and spoken English. German language skills are helpful for local partnership in Penzberg.Your Application Please only upload your up-to-date CV (English) and your latest educational certificates. A motivation letter is not necessary. Internal applicants may apply with their comprehensive workday profile. Please note that no additional documents can be submitted after your application has been sent.We look forward to receiving your application.  Your contact to us! With people. For people.Do you need further support?Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.Who we areA healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.Let’s build a healthier future, together.Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description: Company:CSR Biotech (www.csr-biotech.eu (http://www.csr-biotech.com/) )Contract:Permanent, Full-time (100%)Location:CSR Biotech Europe Headquarters in Heidelberg, Germany.Company Description:At CSR Biotech, we are committed to advancing the frontiers of scientific and medical innovation.We are growing rapidly in Europe, with our Heidelberg office playing a key role in our global expansion. knowledge of German or Chinese is a plusWhat We Offer- A dynamic, international work environment with a lot of room to grow- The opportunity to be a key team member in a growing Global Operations Hub- Close collaboration with international teams and exciting tech projects- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.- Paid annual leave of 30 working days per year.About CSR Europe GmbHCSR Biotech is a technology-driven company focused on advancing how we observe, understand, and interact with living systems.Founded in 2019, our roots trace back to the interdisciplinary labs of Peking University, where our founding team worked alongside leading scientists in biological imaging. Since then, we have grown into a global organization, with our headquarters in Guangzhou and our European hub in Heidelberg, Germany — which is rapidly evolving into our global commercial center and a key engine for international growth.Today, CSR Biotech brings together a team of over 150 scientists, engineers, and innovators, supported by a 4,000 m² facility that integrates research, development, and manufacturing. Kenntnisse in Deutsch oder Chinesisch sind ein Plus.Was wir anbieten:Ein dynamisches, internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Wachstum.Die Möglichkeit, ein Schlüsselmitglied eines wachsenden Global Operations Hubs zu seinEnge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams und spannende TechnologieprojekteWettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und leistungsbezogene Boni.Bezahlter Jahresurlaub von 30 Arbeitstagen pro Jahr.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Vertrieb
